replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
It's not terrible, but I honestly don't see the point of having more 4-team DTM maps. None of the ones we currently have play well, and the way this looks, it shouldn't be any better.

Simply put, 4-team DTM is destined to have poor gameplay, and I'd rather see people focus their attention on gamemodes we actually need maps for (KoTH, 3/5CP, CTF, etc.).

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We regret to inform you that your map will not be added. We have declined it for the following reasons:

-Looks too simple. There needs to be more structures, more block variation and something to make the map more unique. Right now it seems quite boring and may be played like all the other dtm maps.
- Needs structures, the monument placing is very awkward

If changes are made, you may repost your map with the requests above, and reply to this comment. We will then reevaluate it for further action on whether or not it will be accepted.

Thank you very much for submitting!
